newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Fairfax appoints Steve Harris Age publisher.
newsitem.headline: Fairfax appoints Steve Harris Age publisher.

text.p: John Fairfax Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had appointed Steve Harris as publisher and editor-in-chief of Melbourne's The Age and The Sunday Age newspapers.
Fairfax chief executive Bob Muscat said the appointment follows the resignation of John Reynolds as managing director The Age and The Sunday Age.
Harris, 43, has been a senior executive with News Ltd for the five years.

He was editor-in-chief of The Herald and Weekly Times, publisher of the Herald Sun, Sunday Herald Sun and Weekly Times for four years, before being appointed group senior executive at News Ltd, Sydney.
